description: Adds a new, familiar face to Stardew Valley.

releases.body:
- Fixed hat icon drawing crashing the draw loop when Lacey doesn't exist in the world.
- Updated festival detection to use East Scarp's new mod IDs, since they changed.
- Revealed support for hats added by Cornucopia Cooking Recipes, now that it's been published.

- Fixed 14-heart event not firing when entering BusStop from Town while on a horse.
- Fixed hat_string conversion not stripping commas (matters in Fashion Sense packs).
- Fixed hat_string barfing when no hat is being worn.
- Fixed a collision with Martin (SVE) at Spirit's Eve year 2.
- Added compatibility with Norm's Country Kitchen: Lacey visits the truck and loves pretzels.
- Added hat reactions for the following mods:
    - Mouse Friends in the Forest
    - SH's More Accessories and Stuff
    - several unpublished mods and updates
- Moved forest map patches to priority Late+20 in order to come after Cape Stardew (deleting Lacey's door warp).
- Improved the hat collapse map: better lazy loading, cleared when returning to title or when Data/hats is invalidated.
- Converted the remaining ^ dialogues to switch blocks.
- Increased the duration of villager-specific hat CTs (4 -> 7 days).
- Removed a 1.5-era NoPath tile from the forest map patches which is no longer needed.

- Reworked config setting AlwaysAdopt -> ChildPolicy. Check your config after updating!
- Rearranged the GMCM menu a little bit due to the config change.
- Fixed Lacey's Farmer.modData code to support any farmer, not just the current one.
- Fixed incorrect palette combo: Elle's Town Buildings x A Wittily Named Recolor.
- Fixed turkish (updated vanilla) and chinese (thanks mushymato!) banner overlays.
- Fixed failure to finish loading Fashion Sense hat data when finding a hat with no front model.
- Added non-english language overlays to the Stardew Valley Fair hat stall.
- Added GSQs to check hat registry data.
- Added some hat-based conversation topics for vanilla villagers.
- Added interior recolor support to the spouse portrait.
- Added detection support for the Starblue 1.6 unofficial update.
- Added child sprite live preview to GMCM, in accordance with new ChildPolicy config.
- Added hat commentary:
    - Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius
    - Passerby Cemetery
    - Ridgeside Village
    - Posy's Goggles
    - Lune's Bloom Collection
    - Lune's Dewdrop Collection
    - Lune's Ethereal Collection
    - Lune's Fungi Collection
    - Lune's Harvest Collection
    - Lune's Wildwood Collection

- Fixed Better Crafting menu crash with unseen hat in inventory.
- Fixed Claire (SVE) collision at winter8 when RSV is also installed.
- Fixed missing weather requirement in help document for Fievel crossover event.
- Added commentary for hats from cryomancer's Foraging Walking Mushrooms.
- Added automatic mapping of FS hats back to object hats if they have a FromItemId.
- Added a console command to dump the hat collapse map.

- Fixed wrong pixels in Nouveau winter outdoors portraits.
- Fixed weird text wrapping in Resort_Wander dialogue (added a comma).
- Added alternate lines in some heart events when other mouse character mods are installed.
- Added compat festival location for Mateo (luau, y2).
- Added specific gift reactions for hardwood.
- Added drawing a little icon of Lacey's face on hats she hasn't commented on (with config setting).
- Added collapse feature to hat registry menu (with config setting).
- Added live preview of portraits and sprites to GMCM menu.
- Added a crossover event for Mouse Friends in the Forest.
- Added a crossover event for Fievel Goes East Scarp.
- Added hat reactions for:
    - Seasonal Hats by ParadigmNomad & Pathoschild
    - Halloween Hats & Treats by Sh1ryUwu
    - The Fishmonger by voidwitchcult
    - Shrimp Hat by feen1e
    - Orange Hats by KaileyStardew
- Changed taste reveal in 4-heart event: coffee instead of vanilla alcohols.
- Sped up the new hat boilerplate after the first time seeing it each day.
- Slightly shortened Lacey's resort_towel animation.
